liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Slow, mellow Easy Wind that develops into the band's typical 1969 jamming [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd69-09-11d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [4]

## The recordings

- **gd69-09-11.aud.cotsman.12063.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 1 songs; 8 min; rated 1/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is decent and was probably nice originally, but generations have left it somewhat muddy; useful as filler; The first few notes of the circulating song are clipped [1][2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-09-11.aud.cotsman.12063.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dave Litfin and JCotsman; source: Audience [1]. Also: Only one song from this recording circulates; Sound Forge was used for a slight pitch correction [1]
